content: The MCP specification requires local HTTP servers to validate Origin on all incoming connections to prevent DNS rebinding, responding 403 Forbidden when Origin is present and invalid; bind 127.0.0.1 not 0.0.0.0; authenticate even on localhost. The MCP TypeScript SDK (GHSA-w48q-cv73-mx4w), Python SDK (CVE-2025-66416) and rmcp <1.4.0 (GHSA-89vp-x53w-74fx) all shipped without this by default — hence a guarded test, not a config default. Host validation runs before auth.
